Name: Bean the Tuxedo Cat
Author: DuckVendetta
Description:
Here is my first attempt at making my own mods for Stardew Valley. I thought I'd start simple and patch in my cat.

This mod (hopefully) overrides all three cat textures. Has been tested on cat1 (grey tabby), I have not yet tested it on any other cats.

I had a good bit of fun making this, and I hope some of you might enjoy my little fluff as well!
